title: Ghost IDE 1.1.6beta1
massges:
## Ghostide 1.1.6beta1

- Fix errors reported by users

- Improved text highlighting
- Added new APIs for plugins
- Improved glass mode is now more optimal
- Added an icon to display open files, the number of which is known
- Optimizing the program compared to other versions
- Added settings to turn off glass mode (doesn't work well at the moment, don't test) 
- Improvement of the menu above the code editor
- Fixed the regex search error, the code editor no longer crashes the program
- Improved store ui
- and many other features

## Support 
- Support us by giving us stars
